name: P02_diamond_fringe
motion_prompt: Static panoramic camera on a sparse fringe of suspended brilliant-cut diamonds. The hanging stones gently sway and rotate by small angles in a slow repeating cycle. Soft warm reflections glide across their facets with tiny restrained glints. The central and lower black area remains still and empty. Sophisticated high-jewelry campaign lighting, stable exposure, physically coherent pendulum motion, no flashing, no additional objects or camera movement.
processing: Wan 2.2 first/last frame, 81 frames at 16 fps; crop 2 px top/bottom; optical-flow interpolation to 60 fps; cosine time remap forward then reverse over one 8-second cycle, delivered at 30 fps. Eased reversals avoid a hard cut or a tail-to-head dissolve. ProRes LT master and all-intra H.264 delivery.
